title: Resource Backpacks - Graves Compat
description: Saves your equipped Resource Backpack into your Universal Graves tomb on death, so you don't lose it.
body:
## Resource Backpacks - Graves Compat

A small compatibility mod that ensures your equipped backpack from
**Resource Backpacks** is saved inside your **Universal Graves** tomb
when you die — instead of dropping on the ground or being lost.

### How it works
When you die with a backpack equipped, this mod intercepts the death
event and moves the backpack into the grave generated by Universal
Graves, keeping all its contents safe.

### Requirements
- [Resource Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/resource-backpacks)
- [Universal Graves](https://modrinth.com/mod/universal-graves)
- Fabric Loader ≥ 0.15.0
- Fabric API
